name: Avapritinib (GIST, PDGFRA exon 18 D842V)

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental DRAFT, owner/device test only; not clinically activated). Doses reflect standard-of-care first-line dosing for PDGFRA D842V GIST from general references; original wording, no proprietary guideline text reproduced.

biomarkers.PDGFRA: PDGFRA exon 18 D842V is intrinsically imatinib-resistant; avapritinib is the preferred agent for this genotype
biomarkers.note: Avapritinib is a selective KIT / PDGFRA type-I inhibitor active against the PDGFRA exon 18 D842V mutation that resists imatinib and most other GIST tyrosine kinase inhibitors. It is the preferred first-line agent for advanced D842V-mutant GIST. Not selected for KIT-mutant disease, where imatinib is standard first-line. General reference (Standard Guidelines / DeVita / Harrison); no proprietary guideline text reproduced.

supportiveCare: Continuous oral dosing once daily on an empty stomach; continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity - no fixed cycle count (represented here as days 1 to 28 of a 28-day cycle).
Counsel on the risk of intracranial hemorrhage and cognitive / neuropsychiatric effects (memory, mood, confusion); reduce, interrupt, or stop for significant events.
Avoid strong CYP3A4 inhibitors and inducers where possible; adjust dose per labeling if a strong inhibitor is unavoidable.
Antiemetic / G-CSF prophylaxis not routinely required for oral avapritinib monotherapy.
monitoring: cognitive and neuropsychiatric assessment (memory, mood, confusion) at baseline and each visit
signs of intracranial or other bleeding
clinical / radiographic response assessment (CT; Choi or RECIST criteria)

doseModificationRules.condition: cognitive / neuropsychiatric effects (grade 2 or higher) or any intracranial hemorrhage
doseModificationRules.text: Interrupt and resume at a reduced dose for grade 2 cognitive effects; hold for higher grades and discontinue for intracranial hemorrhage. Obtain clinical review.
Reduce the daily dose per labeling when a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor cannot be avoided. Obtain clinical review.

drugs.name: Avapritinib
drugs.notes: Avapritinib 300 mg PO once daily on an empty stomach, given continuously (represented as days 1 to 28 of a 28-day cycle) until progression or intolerance. Standard first-line dose for PDGFRA exon 18 D842V-mutant advanced GIST. Reduce for cognitive / neuropsychiatric effects, cytopenias, or unavoidable strong CYP3A4 inhibitors per labeling. Standard-of-care dosing from general references (Standard Guidelines / DeVita / Harrison); original wording, no proprietary guideline text reproduced.

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita / Harrison, general reference
provenance.locator: standard first-line dose for PDGFRA D842V advanced GIST (300 mg PO once daily)
